M3 — 2026-10-07
The dev machine's npm moved 11.19 to 12.2 on 2026-10-07. npm 12 runs no install script unless allowed, and its named allow-list (`--allow-scripts=sofar.sh`) matches registry installs only, never a local tarball. A test that installs packed tarballs and needs postinstall must set npm_config_dangerously_allow_all_scripts=true in its scratch prefix. The user-facing hint does work for registry installs (checked on sofar.sh@0.35.0-rc.1).
